rationale: C103 flagged a negative fair_value of -21000 as unexplained, but the raw filing shows the Zarya Intermediate investment line with fair value (21) and footnote (14), and the related commitments schedule identifies Zarya Intermediate, LLC as a Revolver with an unfunded commitment and negative fair value. The source therefore supports this as an unfunded-commitment presentation, not a data error in the extracted fair value.
